sloka: तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारौ निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां तदा ।समुत्सुकौ तौ सममूषतुर्निशां यथा ऽश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् ।। ७.९३.१९ ।।
transliteration: tāmadbhutāṁ tau hṛdaye kumārau niveśya vāṇīmṛṣibhāṣitāṁ tadā ।samutsukau tau samamūṣaturniśāṁ yathā 'śvinau bhārgavanītisaṁhitām ।। 7.93.19 ।।

translations.english: Then, those two princes, having fixed those wonderful words spoken by the sage in their hearts, passed the night with great eagerness, just as the Ashvins awaited the wisdom of Bhargava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 93 ।। Thus ends the ninety-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
